chunks: Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Ahmari, from a group, from Ibn Faddal, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from his father Bukayr ibn A'yan, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام: On which nights should I perform ghusl in the month of Ramadan?
He said: "On the nineteenth, the twenty-first, and the twenty-third; and the ghusl is at the beginning of the night."
I said: What if he sleeps after the ghusl? He said: "It is like the ghusl of Friday: if you perform ghusl after dawn, it suffices you."

key_terms.أَجْزَأَكَ: it sufficed you; it was valid for you
key_terms.أَغْتَسِلُ: I perform ghusl; undertake the ritual bath
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the sacred month of fasting

ai.seo_question: On which nights should ghusl be performed in Ramadan, and does sleeping afterward affect it?
ai.summary: This hadith states the recommended nights for performing ghusl in the month of Ramadan: the nineteenth, twenty-first, and twenty-third nights. It also indicates that the ghusl is done at the beginning of the night, and that sleeping afterward does not invalidate its sufficiency, likening it to the ghusl of Friday.
